jobs.name: Windows Node and Vite artifact gate

steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch --no-tags origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
test "$(git rev-parse "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}^{commit}")" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')).version")"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"

steps.name: Publish verified archive with provenance
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
archive="$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('.artifacts/release/manifest.json', 'utf8')).archive.name")"
npm publish ".artifacts/release/$archive" --access public --provenance

steps.name: Verify registry archive and attestations
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
package="$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('.artifacts/release/manifest.json', 'utf8')).package.name")"
version="$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('.artifacts/release/manifest.json', 'utf8')).package.version")"
expected="$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('.artifacts/release/manifest.json', 'utf8')).archive.sha256")"

mkdir registry-artifact
name=""
for attempt in $(seq 1 120); do
  if name="$(npm pack "$package@$version" --ignore-scripts --pack-destination registry-artifact 2>/dev/null)"; then
    break
  fi
  name=""
  if [ "$attempt" -lt 120 ]; then
    sleep 5
  fi
done
if [ -z "$name" ]; then
  echo "Registry package did not become available within 10 minutes." >&2
  exit 1
fi
test "$(sha256sum "registry-artifact/$name" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "$expected"
test "$(npm view "$package@$version" version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version"

mkdir registry-consumer
(
  cd registry-consumer
  npm init --yes >/dev/null
)
npm install --prefix registry-consumer --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund "$package@$version" >/dev/null

attestation_verified=false
for attempt in $(seq 1 120); do
  if npm audit signatures --prefix registry-consumer --json --include-attestations > "$RUNNER_TEMP/registry-attestations.json" 2>/dev/null &&
    node scripts/verify-registry-attestations.mjs "$RUNNER_TEMP/registry-attestations.json" "$package" "$version" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    attestation_verified=true
    break
  fi
  if [ "$attempt" -lt 120 ]; then
    sleep 5
  fi
done
if [ "$attestation_verified" != true ]; then
  echo "Registry attestations did not become verifiable within 10 minutes." >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Ensure exact GitHub release
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
artifact_dir=".artifacts/release"
lookup_headers="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-lookup.headers"
release_before="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-before.json"
release_after="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-after.json"
release_plan="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-plan.json"
downloaded_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/downloaded-release-assets"
archive="$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('.artifacts/release/manifest.json', 'utf8')).archive.name")"

release_exists=false
if gh api --include --silent "repos/$GH_REPO/releases/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME" > "$lookup_headers" 2>/dev/null; then
  release_exists=true
else
  lookup_status="$(grep -E '^HTTP/[0-9.]+ [0-9]{3}([[:space:]]|$)' "$lookup_headers" | tail -n 1 || true)"
  if ! grep -Eq '^HTTP/[0-9.]+ 404([[:space:]]|$)' <<< "$lookup_status"; then
    echo "GitHub release lookup failed without a confirmed 404; refusing creation." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if [ "$release_exists" = false ]; then
  if ! gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
    --verify-tag \
    --generate-notes \
    --title "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
    "$artifact_dir/$archive" \
    "$artifact_dir/manifest.json"; then
    echo "Release creation was not acknowledged; verifying current release state." >&2
  fi
fi

if ! gh api "repos/$GH_REPO/releases/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME" > "$release_before" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "No verifiable GitHub release exists; manual correction is required before retry." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! node scripts/github-release.mjs plan \
  "$release_before" \
  "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
  "$artifact_dir" > "$release_plan" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "GitHub release state or assets are incomplete or mismatched; manual correction is required before retry." >&2
  exit 1
fi

mkdir "$downloaded_dir"
for asset_index in 0 1; do
  asset_id="$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1], 'utf8')).assets[$asset_index].id" "$release_plan")"
  asset_name="$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1], 'utf8')).assets[$asset_index].name" "$release_plan")"
  gh api \
    -H "Accept: application/octet-stream" \
    "repos/$GH_REPO/releases/assets/$asset_id" > "$downloaded_dir/$asset_name"
done

gh api "repos/$GH_REPO/releases/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME" > "$release_after"
node scripts/github-release.mjs verify \
  "$release_before" \
  "$release_after" \
  "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
  "$artifact_dir" \
  "$downloaded_dir"

steps.name: Confirm release commit is on main
steps.run:
release_commit="$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')"
if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_commit" origin/main; then
  echo "The release commit must be part of the main branch." >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Pack release artifacts
steps.run:
artifact_directory="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-artifact"
mkdir -p "$artifact_directory"
pnpm --filter @astilba/tokens pack --pack-destination "$artifact_directory"
pnpm --filter @astilba/ui pack --pack-destination "$artifact_directory"

mapfile -t tarballs < <(find "$artifact_directory" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'astilba-*.tgz' | sort)
if [[ "${#tarballs[@]}" -ne 2 ]]; then
  echo "Expected exactly two Astilba package tarballs." >&2
  exit 1
fi

(
  cd "$artifact_directory"
  sha256sum "$(basename "${tarballs[0]}")" "$(basename "${tarballs[1]}")" > SHA256SUMS
)

steps.name: Publish verified artifacts
steps.run:
artifact_directory="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-artifact"
mapfile -t tokens_tarballs < <(find "$artifact_directory" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'astilba-tokens-*.tgz')
mapfile -t ui_tarballs < <(find "$artifact_directory" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'astilba-ui-*.tgz')

if [[ "${#tokens_tarballs[@]}" -ne 1 || "${#ui_tarballs[@]}" -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "Expected exactly one tarball for each release package." >&2
  exit 1
fi

npm publish "${tokens_tarballs[0]}" --access public --provenance
npm publish "${ui_tarballs[0]}" --access public --provenance

steps.name: Confirm artifact provenance
steps.run:
if [[ ! "$SHOWCASE_ARTIFACT_DIGEST" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::The verified showcase artifact is missing its SHA-256 digest."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f apps/showcase/dist/index.html || ! -f apps/showcase/dist/_headers || ! -f apps/showcase/dist/robots.txt ]]; then
  echo "::error::The verified showcase artifact is incomplete."
  exit 1
fi

mapfile -t scripts < <(find apps/showcase/dist/assets -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.js')
mapfile -t styles < <(find apps/showcase/dist/assets -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.css')
if [[ "${#scripts[@]}" -lt 1 || "${#styles[@]}" -lt 1 ]]; then
  echo "::error::The verified showcase artifact is missing compiled assets."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Deploying verified showcase artifact sha256:$SHOWCASE_ARTIFACT_DIGEST"

steps.name: Reject a stale main revision
steps.run:
read -r current_main_sha current_main_ref < <(
  git ls-remote --exit-code origin refs/heads/main
)

if [[ "$current_main_ref" != "refs/heads/main" || "$current_main_sha" != "$VERIFIED_SHA" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Refusing to deploy $VERIFIED_SHA because origin/main is $current_main_sha."
  exit 1
fi
